def toggle_middle_bits(n):
    if n < 1:
        return n
    # number of bits excluding the highest bit
    bits = n.bit_length()
    if bits <= 2:
        return n
    # mask to toggle all bits except first (MSB) and last (LSB)
    mask = ((1 << (bits - 1)) - 1) & ~1
    return n ^ mask
